definition: In four words the zaida ya may be kept or dropped when joined, and is dropped when stopped: الداع (al-Baqara 186), دعان (al-Baqara 186), التلاق (Ghafir 15), التناد (Ghafir 32).
limitations: Only the longer book Nabhan is cited; Book A does not have this topic.
Paraphrase of the cited pages by an automated drafter; not scholarly reviewed.
A closed list in the Kufian numbering used by the book.
Both joined readings are listed in `variants`; the corpus writes the dropped one and none is chosen.

conditions.description: The word is one of the four named, at the named place.
